task.name: pour_sausage_into_pot
task.description: Use the left arm to pour the sausages from the plate into the pot, then use the right arm to place the lid on the pot.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the plate.
2. Grasp the plate with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the pot.
4. Pour the sausages from the plate into the pot.
5. Move the right arm to approach and align with the lid.
6. Grasp the lid with the right arm.
7. Move the right arm to align with the pot.
8. Release the gripper to place the lid on the pot.
